sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins and an unbeaten run of six matches (W-D-W-W-W-W), while Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are struggling badly with only one win in their last six outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a test away at Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach after their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a match between two strong sides—Bridgnorth sit third with a recent loss but excellent overall form, while Eccleshall occupy fifth spot and recently suffered a defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in an all-Wolverhampton encounter, with Casuals in good recent form (W-W-D-W-L-W) while Wednesfield sit mid-table. Bilston Town, currently sixth, face Foley Meir at home in a battle between well-matched mid-table sides. Shawbury United face Barnton, with Shawbury's alarming run of five straight losses (L-L-L-L-L) contrasting sharply against Barnton's steadier recent record. Cheadle Heath Nomads, second-bottom, travel to Market Drayton Town in a struggle between struggling sides. New Mills host Market Drayton Town away, with New Mills on a difficult spell (L-L-D-L-W-D) while Drayton are inconsistent. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath, both teams in mid-table difficulty. Finally, Brereton Social are at home to bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town, who remain winless with just 2 points from 7 games.
